'''R4-E1''' (pronounced '''Arfour-Eeone''') was a vehicle computer-operation [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in a standard casing of the [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Biography==
[[File:R4-E1_-_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|left|R4-E1]]
R4-E1 was capable of repairing and [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] numerous vehicles. R4-E1 developed a rambunctious, fiercely independent personality. He was the companion of the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]], [[BoShek/Legends|BoShek]].<ref name="CCG" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], R4-E1 was passing by [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] [[Spaceport Speeders/Legends|Spaceport Speeders]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sold Skywalker's [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]] to help pay [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] for passage to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref><ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>
